unit: Unit 13: Making Your Computer Easier to Use
title: Colour filters
drDigitalIntro:
About one man in twelve finds certain colour pairs hard to tell apart — most often red and green.
• A colour filter changes how the computer shows colour so those pairs stop clashing.
• Greyscale removes colour entirely: everything becomes shades of grey. Nothing depends on hue any more.
• Warm shifts the whole screen toward orange, which some people find easier on the eyes at night.
• Off is the third choice, and it is where you started.

playgroundTask.goal: You switched the screen to greyscale

steps.say: Click Accessibility in the list on the left.
Under Colour Filters, click the Greyscale button.

drDigitalSuccess: All the colour drained out. Look at the dock — the app tiles are now told apart by their shapes, not their colours.
drDigitalHint: Colour Filters is the row of three buttons at the bottom of the Colour and Contrast card.
